proposals.current_spec: When `None`, each drive's actor falls back to the first available CPU in its NUMA node (all drives on the same node would share that core).
proposals.current_code: The dispatchers assign NUMA-local cores round-robin, excluding each node's first two; block-device fallback / unpinned cases as in dispatcher FR-011.
proposals.proposed: Doc comment corrected. FR-018 lists `poller_base_cpu` by name only, so no spec text change was needed.
